source.name: UNEP Food Waste Index Report 2024
source.publisher: United Nations Environment Programme and WRAP

cadence: Refresh when UNEP publishes a new Food Waste Index global assessment.
provenance: Source-reported global estimates from the UNEP Food Waste Index Report 2024 and its official key messages. Sector totals and shares retain the report boundary: household, food service and retail food waste, including inedible parts.
uncertainty: UNEP estimates every country using observed per-capita studies and United Nations population statistics, including extrapolation where primary data are absent. Retail and food-service uncertainty is substantial; 2019 and 2022 global estimates are not treated as a measured trend because coverage and methods changed. Manufacturing food waste is omitted for insufficient evidence.
failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed report snapshot and mark stale; never treat an unmeasured country or sector as zero, compare assessment editions as a trend without harmonization, or extend the consumer-and-retail estimate to manufacturing.

assessment.geography_boundary: Global estimate constructed for every country in the world
